description: This file defines the Rotate3dAnimation class, a custom animation for rotating a view about the Y axis with 3D effects in Android. It includes setup for rotation angles, pivot points, depth translation, and applies transformation using Android's Camera and Matrix classes.

classes.name: Rotate3dAnimation
classes.description: A custom Animation subclass that performs a 3D rotation around the Y-axis, including depth translation to create a more realistic effect.

methods.name: Rotate3dAnimation
methods.description: Constructor to initialize rotation angles, pivot points, depth, and reversal flag.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the camera object, called when animation starts, setting up the necessary graphics environment.

methods.name: applyTransformation
methods.description: Calculates and applies the rotation and translation transformations during the animation's progress.
